profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: I do web and graphic design as well as backend work (mostly LAMP environments). I'm good at introducing people to the world of website ownership and management in a way they can understand.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed custom e-commerce modules using PHP, mySQL, and JavaScript. Provided customer support over phone and email and tutored junior developers in PHP and mySQL.

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.description: Worked in PHP, Javascript, and CSS to develop and maintain the staffing software used nationwide in SOS Employment Group's offices (now a part of Elwood Staffing). Rebranded the SOS Employment Group website when the company changed its name and provided tech support and custom graphics.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Jack of all trades! Worked as the front desk secretary and answered tech support calls. Also was in charge of maintaining and updating the company website and support forums. Created help tutorial videos as well as several advertisement email templates.

positions.title: Food Service Worker
positions.description: Provided friendly service and good food to the people on the Katterbach, Germany Army Base while I was living over there. Helped train new employees in customer service and food preparation.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Maintained website's JSP backend and worked with the Athletics team to create new user-friendly features. Performed website-related tech support for both staff and users.
